abilities.effect: A 30‑foot cone of force issues forth from the lock. Creatures within the cone must succeed a DC 29 basic Fortitude saving throw or take 8d12 force damage. Those who fail the save are pushed 10 feet, and those who critically fail are pushed 20 feet and are stunned 2.
abilities.name: Force Blast

traits.name: Evocation
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the evocation school of magic, typically involving energy and elemental forces.

traits.name: Force
traits.text: Effects with this trait deal force damage or create objects made of pure magical force.

traits.name: Occult
traits.text:
This magic comes from the occult tradition, calling upon bizarre and ephemeral mysteries. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to occult magic.

abilities.trigger: A non‑undead creature opens the door or critically fails an attempt to disarm or dispel the rune

hazard.description: A hard-to-reach rune is placed on the lock’s tumbler. It emits a blast of force when the door is jostled.
hazard.disable: DC 32 Thievery (master) to disarm the rune, or *dispel magic* (5th level; counteract DC 28) to counteract the rune’s magic.
hazard.name: Blast Tumbler
hazard.reset: The rune resets 1 minute after it triggers.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
